newsitem.title: USA: Sen.Lott - would be prepared to vote for China MFN.
newsitem.headline: Sen.Lott - would be prepared to vote for China MFN.

text.p: Senate Majority Leader Trent Lott said Wednesday he would be prepared to vote for China Most Favored Nation (MFN) status, but that human rights issues could not be ignored.

"I have voted for China MFN in the past and I would be prepared to do it again this year," Lott said. "We cannot ignore their human rights violations, we cannot ignore the religious persecution," the Mississippi Republican added.
He said the MFN issue should not come up as often as it does, but "I think we'll work through it in a reasonable way."

Lott also said he supported fast-track legislation aimed at extending the North American Free Trade Agreement to Chile, but not any provisions related to labor unions and the environment that President Clinton wants included.
"He's not going to get that and he (Clinton) needs to get over it," Lott told the National Retail Federation.
